title: Model Predictive Control for output tracking with prescribed performance
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) offers a versatile framework for constraint handling and multi-objective optimisation, yet practical application faces challenges regarding initial and recursive feasibility, robustness against model mismatches, and sampled-data constraints. This thesis develops a novel MPC framework for a class of non-linear continuous-time systems governed by functional differential equations.
